g.text: R003: intrinsic gain versus drain current
W = 50 μm; μnCox = 134 μA/V²; λ = (0.1 V⁻¹)(0.5 μm/L)
Strong-inversion square law, saturation maintained; ro ≈ 1/(λID).
No extrapolation to ID = 0; this model excludes subthreshold.
